ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.claim: The compiled program is destroyed by a restored attention site that is SIMULTANEOUSLY near-parallel to its own table row and far larger than it, and by neither property alone. attn17 (cosine +0.9472) amplified collapses 7.53 -> 2.74x at an effective ratio of 149.3x; attn3 (cosine +0.7001) amplified to an effective 415.9x climbs to 12.17x, well ABOVE the 7.16/7.29/7.49 baseline. Same multipliers, opposite outcomes, cosine the only difference.
ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.mechanism_reading: A site parallel to its table row contributes more of what the program already has; amplifying it overwhelms the residual stream along a direction every downstream table was calibrated against. A site at cosine +0.70 adds a largely NEW direction, which acts like restoring genuine context — which is why attn3 gets BETTER.
ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.mlp_profile_is_depth_ordered: §1898's per-MLP change-rate profile is best ordered by DEPTH (Spearman +0.785), then cosine (+0.637), then norm ratio (-0.610), then the conjunction (-0.389). Depth and cosine are not independent here, so depth is reported as the better ORDERING, not as the mechanism.
ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.natural_cases: attn5 (144.0x, cos +0.9992) -> 1.06x and attn6 (77.1x, +0.9866) -> 1.32x are the only two sites in the model that naturally satisfy both properties.
ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.precision_S1916: the designed falsification is 50-100 spreads clear of the estimator noise: attn17 amplified 2.743+-0.034 against a 7.097+-0.055 baseline. Nothing in §1908 depended on the estimator's precision.
ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.quantitative_match: attn17's onset at 149.3x against attn5's natural 144.0x — within 4%.
ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.scope: SUFFICIENCY is demonstrated — the conjunction was built and the program collapsed on all three roles. NECESSITY is supported by the 18-site survey (§1905, §1907) but not proved. BOUNDED TO ATTENTION at §1909: the 18 MLP sites carry uncovered live/table norm ratios of only 1.18x-1.76x against the attention collapsers' 77x-144x, so they have the alignment (median cosine +0.9587 uncovered, +1.000000 covered) and not the magnitude. §1908 therefore predicts no MLP collapse and §1903 measured none — consistent, with the law simply having nothing to act on.
ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908.status: CERTIFIED — all four predictions TRUE on a designed falsification test

ALPHA_FAILS_THE_STOPPING_RULE_S1968.claim: Applying S1967's stopping rule to S1961's own artifact (no GPU): alpha FAILS on 6 of 6 role-coverage cells -- the three grid points around its optimum span 2.10/3.48/1.19 milli-nats at 5,419 and 0.57/1.08/0.51 at 16,110, against a 0.50 bar and up to seven times the tilt's span. It is not a grid-density artefact: the two grids have comparable spacing.
ALPHA_FAILS_THE_STOPPING_RULE_S1968.consequence: Alpha is worth pinning to +-5 points and the tilt is not. S1961 swept 10/20/25/30/40/50 and never looked between 0.25 and 0.35, where the optimum sits on 5 of 6 cells.
ALPHA_FAILS_THE_STOPPING_RULE_S1968.corrected_by: S1970: the failure WAS resolution. At 24/26/28/30/32/34/36 the three-point span is 0.06-0.15 milli-nats. S1968's argument that the grids had comparable spacing confused alpha POINTS with what a point costs -- S1961's grid straddled the steep 0.30->0.40 step. S1968's correction of S1961's characterisation stands.
ALPHA_FAILS_THE_STOPPING_RULE_S1968.corrects_S1961: S1961 called alpha 'flat and effectively optimal' by noting alpha=0.10 costs +10 to +12 milli-nats -- flat RELATIVE TO THE FAR ENDS of the grid. S1967's rule asks what being ONE GRID STEP off costs: for alpha up to 3.48 milli-nats (alpha=0.40 is expensive), for the tilt under 0.5. 'Flat compared to a bad value' is not 'flat near the optimum'. S1961's operational advice (0.25 and 0.30 interchangeable, worth 0.08-1.19 milli-nats) survives; the characterisation does not.
ALPHA_FAILS_THE_STOPPING_RULE_S1968.limitation_of_the_rule: Stated now rather than discovered later: the three-point span is sensitive to ASYMMETRY, not only flatness. Alpha's large span is driven mostly by 0.40 being bad while 0.25 is close; a rule measuring only the better neighbour would call it settled. The two-sided form is kept deliberately -- the cost of landing one step the WRONG way is what makes an axis worth pinning -- but it should be read as 'how much does a one-step error cost', not 'is the curve symmetric and flat'.
ALPHA_FAILS_THE_STOPPING_RULE_S1968.open: S1967's rule has been applied to two axes and retro-applied to a third. The other two settled axes -- table rank (S1947/S1950) and attention share (S1948/S1952) -- were closed before the rule existed, on the 0.010 nats/100M threshold, which asks about cost-efficiency and not about the penalty for a one-step error. Both artifacts are on disk and the same arithmetic applies.

ARC_HEADLINE_POOLED_S1972.claim: Pooled across all three roles on 92,160 positions, the converged build beats S1789's deployed design by 69.238 milli-nats at paired t = -42.76 -- no vote, and STRONGER than the best single role (-27.74), because pooling uses every position rather than the best third. Every '3/3 roles' in S1946-S1971 can be restated this way from cached artifacts.
ARC_HEADLINE_POOLED_S1972.controls: Derived: coverage exact; same-spec pairs inert at covered inputs and differing-spec pairs not; buckets partition; live per-cell identical; S1970's published a30 CE reproduced to 0.000000 via B.ref(). Fifty-third clean reading.
ARC_HEADLINE_POOLED_S1972.dissenting_role_confirmed: skip1200's per-role t on the tilt is -0.33 against skip11000's -2.28 -- the half-sized role contributing the weakest evidence, and under a vote it would have counted the same (S1971).

ARC_HEADLINE_POOLED_S1972.general_point: On 92,160 positions almost anything real becomes detectable. A t-test answers 'is the effect nonzero'; a build decision needs 'is the effect worth its cost'. The arc needs both: significance to believe an effect, magnitude to buy it. Every marginal purchase from S1957 on was decided on magnitude against S1947's 0.010 nats/100M, vindicated by S1958, and none should be re-litigated on a t-value.
ARC_HEADLINE_POOLED_S1972.my_predicate_was_wrong: I registered that S1967's tilt would be 'not significant even pooled', with the consequence that a failure would mean 'the stopping rule fired too early'. It is significant (pooled t = -2.23) and the rule did NOT fire too early: the tilt is worth -0.266 milli-nats, 0.4% of the converged build's 69.238-milli-nat margin. S1967 asked 'is this worth buying' and answered on magnitude, correctly; my predicate asked 'is this detectable' and treated the answers as interchangeable. LESSON 91.
ARC_HEADLINE_POOLED_S1972.open: The pooled instrument has been applied to three comparisons. Every 2-of-3 in S1946-S1971 could be restated with it from cached data, and S1965's boundary claim most needs it -- it rested on 16,110/skip1200, now known to be the half-sized role, and S1966 corrected it on other grounds without ever pooling.
ARC_HEADLINE_POOLED_S1972.status: CERTIFIED for pred_a and pred_c. pred_b FAILED and the fault is in my predicate.

Untruncating attention sites above 384 buys 0.03x to 0.12x its price at every block tested, at both coverages: attention 14-17 +0.000053 against a 0.00202 price at 5,419 (0.03x) and +0.000240 at 16,110 (0.12x); attention 10-17 0.06x/0.10x; all eighteen 0.06x/0.08x. ATTENTION_384_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_S2022.status: CERTIFIED as a NEGATIVE. S1959's attention 384 stands.
ATTENTION_384_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_S2022.the_17_fold_asymmetry: Normalising for price, extra rank at the best MLP block returns 2.1x and at the best attention block 0.12x -- a 17-fold difference in what the same parameters buy.

Attention contributions are small and flat; MLP contributions span three orders of magnitude and are back-loaded (S2015). A uniform rank is a bad fit for a heterogeneous axis and a fine one for a homogeneous axis.

ATTENTION_5_IS_PRESENCE_ATTENTION_6_IS_C.CONFIRMED_IN_SIGN_ONLY_BY_S1999: S1999 ran the same null at mlp4. The qualitative split transfers -- attention 5 negative (-0.017/-0.017/-0.020), attention 6 positive (+0.095/+0.098/+0.080) -- so it is a fact about the layers. The MAGNITUDE does not: attention 6 content is worth +0.09 at mlp4 against +0.21 at mlp2, roughly half, so HOW MUCH attention 6 must carry is a fact about the pair rather than the layer.
ATTENTION_5_IS_PRESENCE_ATTENTION_6_IS_C.claim: Under the meanrow null -- every token the same row, zero information, only context-freeness -- the threshold's two attention layers separate by an order of magnitude and in opposite directions. A mean row at ATTENTION 5 is BETTER than its compiled table: 1.940/2.047/1.881 against 1.971/2.090/1.952, pooled -0.044 at t = -23.0. A mean row at ATTENTION 6 costs +0.209 at pooled t = +157.2. Mean rows at both cost no more than a mean row at attention 6 alone (2.180 vs 2.183).
ATTENTION_5_IS_PRESENCE_ATTENTION_6_IS_C.evidence: ops/presence_or_content_at_attention_five.py, 53.8s, nine arms x three roles at 5,419, using composite arms. pred_a/b/c all True 3/3, derived controls True, both reference deviations 0.000000.
ATTENTION_5_IS_PRESENCE_ATTENTION_6_IS_C.open: Everything from S1996 to S1998 used mlp2 as the compiled MLP. S1990's minimal path used mlp4, whose lone-site damage is 2.2x larger. The presence/content split has never been checked at a second MLP -- a rung-2 second-class confirm, run as S1999.
ATTENTION_5_IS_PRESENCE_ATTENTION_6_IS_C.the_three_roles: mlp2 / mlp4 -- must be compiled, content IRRELEVANT (S1983: a mean row costs the same 10.67). attention 5 -- must be PRESENT, content slightly NEGATIVE (-0.044 nats). attention 6 -- must be present AND carries content worth +0.209 nats, low-dimensional: rank 16 recovers 72% of it (S1996). Removing all of attention 6's content costs about what removing 24/25ths of its rank did, which is what a low-dimensional signal looks like.

ATTENTION_5_IS_PURE_PRESENCE_IN_EVERY_RO.attention_5_closed: Six sections, four roles, pure presence in every one: required for the fix (S1992), content worthless when repairing (S1998, -0.044), the only lever on the ceiling (S2006, -2.65), content worthless there too (S2007, -0.19). Nothing about what attention 5 WRITES has mattered in any configuration measured -- only that it stops varying with context. The one site whose content does matter is attention 6, worth 0.08-0.22 nats depending on the compiled MLP (S2000), and low-dimensional: rank 16 recovers 72% (S1996).
ATTENTION_5_IS_PURE_PRESENCE_IN_EVERY_RO.claim: Attention 5's lever action is presence-only, like every other role it plays. With attention 6 LIVE, a mean row at attention 5 -- zero information -- is BETTER than its compiled table by 0.176/0.192/0.241 nats (in the repaired configuration S1998 measured that advantage at 0.044, so as a lever it is four to five times larger). Truncating its table to rank 16 costs +0.001/+0.001/+0.000: the lever is entirely intact at 1/24th of the capacity.

ATTENTION_5_IS_UNIQUELY_THE_LEVER_S2006.claim: Attention 5 is the only layer below attention 6 that moves anything. Attention 0-3 give 0.018 (S2005). Attention 5 gives 2.65 nats off the ceiling with attention 6 still live. And adding attention 4 on top of attention 5 makes it WORSE, 8.199 against 8.021, +0.178 for a site whose standalone contribution is exactly zero.
ATTENTION_5_IS_UNIQUELY_THE_LEVER_S2006.evidence: ops/is_attention_five_uniquely_the_lever.py, 47.8s, ten arms x three roles at 5,419. pred_a/b/c all True 3/3, derived controls True, all three reference deviations 0.000000.

Its CONTENT is worthless or harmful -- a mean row beats its compiled table by 0.044 nats (S1998), rank 16 costs 0.010 against rank 384 (S1997). 3. The ONLY site that reduces damage without repairing it -- 2.65 nats off the ceiling with attention 6 live, where attention 4 gives 0.000 and attention 0-3 give 0.018. 4. It explains S1981's below_all = 9.266 entirely, which S2005 showed attention 0-3 cannot.

ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_HAS_NO_SIMPLE_FORM_S.claim: Attention 6's content value is pair-specific with no statable form. Across four compiled MLPs, a mean row at attention 6 costs +0.137 (mlp5), +0.212 (mlp2), +0.099 (mlp3), +0.095 (mlp4) at skip7000. Ordered by the site's lone damage the sequence RISES THEN FALLS; ordered by layer it FALLS THEN RISES. Neither ordering works. It is strictly positive at all four sites on all three roles (0.080-0.216), so attention 6 is always a content site; only the amount is pair-specific.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_HAS_NO_SIMPLE_FORM_S.corrects_S1999: S1999 read an inverse relationship off two points. A third and fourth show it was two points.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_HAS_NO_SIMPLE_FORM_S.evidence: ops/is_attention_six_content_monotone.py, 52.6s, eleven arms x three roles at 5,419. pred_a True 3/3 (both anchors rebuild to S1998/S1999 within 0.005 nats), pred_c True 3/3, pred_b FALSE 3/3. Derived controls True, all three reference deviations 0.000000.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_HAS_NO_SIMPLE_FORM_S.open: That gives the threshold a domain, never measured. mlp6 and mlp7 sit at lone damages of 0.202 and 0.072, an order of magnitude below mlp5's 2.022, so the fix should be a much larger net loss there. The crossing point -- the lone damage at which compiling attention 5 and 6 starts to pay -- is a number this line has implied since S1985 and never quoted. S2001 runs it.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_HAS_NO_SIMPLE_FORM_S.status: CERTIFIED as a NEGATIVE on the trend; the positivity is CERTIFIED.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_HAS_NO_SIMPLE_FORM_S.unregistered_observation: THE FIRST SITE THE PAIR DOES NOT RESCUE. Compiling mlp5 with attention 5 and 6 costs 2.263 nats where compiling mlp5 alone costs 2.022. The reason is arithmetic: a lone attention 5 costs 0.241 and a lone attention 6 about the same (S1989), so for a site whose own damage is already near 2 nats the fix adds more than it removes. The threshold describes how to rescue a BADLY compiled site, and mlp5 is not badly compiled.

ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_IS_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_.claim: Attention 6's content -- (mean row - table), the part a context-free row cannot supply, worth 0.212/0.216/0.191 nats at a compiled mlp2 -- is genuinely HIGH-dimensional. Share recovered by rank: r1 -12.7/-15.4/-21.5% (a rank-1 table is measurably WORSE than a constant row), r4 +2.6/+0.7/-3.3% (worth exactly a constant row), r16 21.9/20.8/17.0%, r64 58.3/56.6/53.6%, r128 81.1/80.0/78.7%. Roughly linear in log-rank from 16 upward, with nothing below 16 at all.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_IS_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_.closes_the_rank_line: There is no small set of directions to name. The head-level probe S2008 and S2009 were building toward is NOT motivated by this evidence.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_IS_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_.evidence: ops/attention_sixs_content_by_rank.py, 4.9s warm, ten arms x three roles at 5,419, measured from the mean-row baseline. pred_a True 3/3, pred_b True 3/3, pred_c FALSE by 3.6/6.6/8.3 points. Derived controls True, both reference deviations 0.000000.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_IS_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_.open: Three sections used the wrong denominator and two headlines came from it. The corrected instrument has not been asked whether high-dimensionality is specific to attention 6 or generic: the same content-by-rank curve for attention 5 (content negative) and for a compiled mlp2 (content essentially zero, S1983) would say -- the S1995 control, one level up.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_IS_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_.status: CERTIFIED, and it SCOPES S1996's interpretation.
ATTENTION_6_CONTENT_IS_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_.the_corrected_account: Attention 6's contribution to a compiled MLP is mostly PRESENCE, which any context-free row supplies. Its CONTENT is small and high-dimensional: half needs 64 directions, four fifths needs 128.

ATTENTION_6_NEEDS_ALMOST_NO_CAPACITY_S19.INTERPRETATION_SCOPED_BY_S2011: The measurements stand; the 'low-dimensional' reading is WITHDRAWN. The 72% is a share of the arm that OMITS attention 6, which S2010 showed is 64-69% presence -- not a share of its content. Measured against the mean row (the only baseline whose difference is content by construction), rank 16 buys 17-22% and rank 4 buys nothing a constant row does not. Attention 6's content needs 64 directions for half and 128 for four fifths. LESSON 99.
ATTENTION_6_NEEDS_ALMOST_NO_CAPACITY_S19.claim: Attention 6's table needs almost no capacity. With mlp2 + attention 5 + attention 6 compiled, sweeping attention 6's table rank gives 2.137 (r16) / 2.109 (r32) / 2.060 (r64) / 2.011 (r128) / 1.971 (r384) at skip7000, against 2.556 for the same arm with attention 6 removed. A 24-fold capacity cut costs 0.166 nats where removing the site costs 0.611: rank 16 captures 72% of attention 6's whole contribution, rank 128 captures 93%. Smooth and roughly linear in log-rank, not a cliff.
ATTENTION_6_NEEDS_ALMOST_NO_CAPACITY_S19.evidence: ops/how_much_of_attention_six.py, 4.8s warm (289.2s cold), nine arms x three roles at 5,419, using per-site table ranks added to bqlib for this. pred_a/b/c all True 3/3, derived controls True on the third plan, reference deviation 0.000000. r16 vs r384 is +0.166 at pooled t = +184.8.
ATTENTION_6_NEEDS_ALMOST_NO_CAPACITY_S19.interpretation: It is NOT enough that attention 6 merely stop varying with context -- capacity buys real CE monotonically at every rank tested. But the amount needed is tiny, so whatever attention 6 must supply to the layers above it is low-dimensional.
ATTENTION_6_NEEDS_ALMOST_NO_CAPACITY_S19.library_bug_found: Three plans before a clean control. Run 1 had no same-spec pair (control_is_two_sided FAILED). Run 2 put the fallback partner at the same THREE sites and it was NOT inert -- correctly: the S1765/S1936 covered-input guarantee rests on attention being DELETED, true only at all 36 sites. bqlib now refuses to call a partial-site pair inert, with a test. Every partial-substitution run since S1977 passed that control because it happened to carry an all-36 pair; they were right by luck and are now right by construction. LESSON 98.
ATTENTION_6_NEEDS_ALMOST_NO_CAPACITY_S19.open: Attention 5 has never been swept, and the threshold names both. If attention 5 is equally shallow the requirement is about presence, not capacity; if it is steep, the two layers are doing different jobs and the asymmetry is the first mechanical handle this line has offered.

ATTENTION_SHARE_IS_MONOTONE_S1948.claim: At 16,110 with mlp fixed at 768 and the S1944 blend fallback, pooled CE is STRICTLY MONOTONE DECREASING in the attention rank across 64/128/192/256/384/576 on all three roles (18/18 points). There is no interior optimum: the CE argmin is 576 -- 75% of the MLP rank -- on every role, three times the top of S1928's 12.5-25% band.
ATTENTION_SHARE_IS_MONOTONE_S1948.controls: S1946's two-sided form: coverage exactly 16,110; a rank-differing arm DOES move covered-input predictions while an identical-spec arm does NOT; buckets partition; live per-cell top-1 and CE identical at 0.00e+00; S1946's published CE reproduced to 0.000005 nats (thirty-fourth clean reading). The blend_mlpheavy_anchor arm and blend_768_256 are the same specification and returned BIT-IDENTICAL.
ATTENTION_SHARE_IS_MONOTONE_S1948.converged_build: Two axes, both measured to their knees at 16,110, agreeing on one build: blend_768_256 -- 36 tables at mlp 768 / attn 256, fallback = 25% output-NN neighbour + 75% rank-256 map, 339.558M. Beats S1931's previous best-known on both instruments at 21.2M less (S1946); nothing cheaper beats S1931 at all (S1947); more attention capacity runs at a quarter of the threshold rate (S1948).
ATTENTION_SHARE_IS_MONOTONE_S1948.corrects_S1928: S1928-S1935 stated 12.5-25% of the per-site table budget for attention as an ALLOCATION OPTIMUM. It is not: CE keeps improving above it. It is an EFFICIENCY band -- where the marginal RATE crosses. Going 256 -> 576 costs +99.4M for 0.0023/0.0026/0.0013 nats per 100M, a quarter of S1947's 0.010 threshold and an eighth of what the same money buys on the MLP axis; going 64 -> 256 runs at 0.0241/0.0267/0.0179 per 100M, well above it. The rule is right and its justification was wrong.
ATTENTION_SHARE_IS_MONOTONE_S1948.evidence: ops/attention_share_at_knee.py, 5.9s. Six attention ranks x three roles at 16,110, per-position top-1 and CE with a paired t on every CE margin.
ATTENTION_SHARE_IS_MONOTONE_S1948.open: Both knees were located with the FALLBACK FIXED at S1944's mix25m256, and S1944 chose alpha=0.25 and rank 256 on FULL-RANK tables at 5,419. S1948 shows the MLP/attention tradeoff moved when the operating point moved; the fallback's own two parameters have never been re-opened AT THE KNEE, where the tables are 78% of the build rather than 97%.
ATTENTION_SHARE_IS_MONOTONE_S1948.status: CERTIFIED for pred_b (3/3) and pred_d; pred_a and pred_c both FALSE 0/3, and together they correct S1928.

BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.claim: At 5,419 coverage, filling each uncovered row with a CONVEX BLEND of the output-NN neighbour row and a rank-512 map row (mix50m512: 50/50) strictly beats map512 -- the build the CE objective preferred since S1938 -- on BOTH instruments with significance: top-1 +0.30/+0.33/+0.41pp AND CE -0.0174/-0.0147/-0.0225 nats at paired t = -5.69/-4.34/-4.64, on 3/3 roles, at 0.03% higher cost (267.335M vs 267.246M). This closes the S1937/S1938 objective fork.
BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.controls: coverage exactly 5,419; every arm inert at covered inputs; buckets partition; live per-cell top-1 and CE identical across all seven arms at 0.00e+00; the nn75m512/map512/map64 anchors reproduced S1940/S1941's published pooled top-1 to 0.005pp (twenty-eighth clean reading).
BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.evidence: ops/route_or_blend.py, 57.0s, seven arms x three roles, per-position top-1 and CE with a paired t on every CE margin. Written against ops/bqlib.py.
BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.frontier: mix50m512 (267.335M) dominates map512 and levels nn75m512; mix25m512 is CE-optimal; the 230.087M deployed design is dominated by all of them.
BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.mechanism: The blend is strongly SUPERADDITIVE: every blended arm beats the LINEAR INTERPOLATION of the nn and map512 endpoint CEs at its own alpha -- 9/9 cells, by -0.030 to -0.047 nats. A convex combination can only beat its endpoints' interpolation if the two ingredients contribute along DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS in row space. The neighbour's top-1 contribution and the map's CE contribution are largely orthogonal, which is why no router could take both: routing forces a per-token choice between two things that were never competing. S1939 found the same shape for routing but an order of magnitude weaker.
BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.open: alpha was swept at three points and 50% is a CORNER of the grid, not a measured optimum; the map rank is fixed at 512; every figure is at 5,419. S1940 is the precedent for 16,110 -- the fallback arm falls from ~24% to ~10% of positions and margins roughly halve.
BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.status: CERTIFIED -- all four registered predicates TRUE (3/3 each).
BLENDING_CLOSES_THE_FORK_S1942.vs_other_champion: mix50m512 against S1941's nn75m512: top-1 -0.04/-0.04/+0.01pp (~15 tokens of 36,864 -- a tie, and NO significance test on a top-1 difference was registered) while CE improves by -0.0417/-0.0422/-0.0389 nats. COST_IS_NOT_ADDITIVE_OVER_SITES_S1981.claim: With attention at layer 6 LIVE, compiling only the six MLPs at layers 0-5 costs 10.60-10.96 nats -- 3.9x the price of compiling all thirty-six sites (2.70-2.98) -- while compiling twenty-two sites ABOVE layer 6 costs 2.42-2.67, LESS than the full program. COST_IS_NOT_ADDITIVE_OVER_SITES_S1981.mechanism: There is ONE forbidden configuration -- context-free rows arriving at a LIVE attention layer 6 -- and every other combination measured is within 0.4 nats of the program. This closes the line S1978 opened: S1978 found partial compilation 3.6x worse than full and called the program 'internally consistent'; S1979 localised it to three layers, S1980 to one, and the consistency the program needs is a SINGLE INTERFACE, not a global property. Thirty-five sites do not care what their inputs are made of; layer 6's attention does.
COST_IS_NOT_ADDITIVE_OVER_SITES_S1981.open: Every arm substitutes layer 6's inputs or leaves them live wholesale; nothing separates what layer 6 READS from what it WRITES, and the six MLPs below it are compiled together. Which of the six, and whether the damage is in layer 6's attention PATTERN or its output MAGNITUDE, are the two questions S1908's alignment x magnitude instrument was built for.

FRESH_WINDOW_RETRACTS_THE_CONVERGED_BUIL.the_check_was_recorded_as_impossible: S2028 stated the backlog's fresh-window rung cannot be satisfied with what is on disk. That was wrong. bilin18_eval_tokens_large.pt -- 512 rows, 510 distinct prefixes, zero overlap with all five fit and eval caches -- was in the working directory the whole time. FRESH_WINDOW_RETRACTS_THE_CONVERGED_BUIL.what_went_wrong: Fifteen sections each measured a real, significant, pooled margin on 92,160 positions, and each margin was 1 to 3 milli-nats on a build whose distance from the live model is about 2,800. A 0.1% effect selected fifteen times over on the same rows is a fitted quantity. S2029 and S2030 had already shown these gains concentrated at covered inputs, the cells most sensitive to which rows are looked at; that was read as a qualification when it was a warning.

FULL_REGISTRY_AUDIT_53_OF_111_AT_RISK_S2.claim: Re-keying S2048's 77 untriaged certified entries on nats against the same 0.030-nat threshold: 31 are safe by scale, 24 are AT RISK, and 22 quote no numeric quantity at all. Total across both passes: 53 of 111 certified entries in the selection-noise regime, 36 safe by scale, 22 untriageable. The 24 are dominated by the build lineage itself -- S1870, S1880, S1928, S1941, S1943-S1950, S1952, S1954, S1958, S1959 -- at margins of 0.00001 to 0.0244 nats.
FULL_REGISTRY_AUDIT_53_OF_111_AT_RISK_S2.evidence: Infrastructure audit, no GPU. Regex over quoted nat-scale quantities in the registry.
FULL_REGISTRY_AUDIT_53_OF_111_AT_RISK_S2.open: The lineage's net is validated and its steps are not, and those are different facts. The largest single at-risk step is S1941's nn75m512 dominating the deployed design at 0.0244 nats, expressible in the current arm grammar and testable in one arm. If a step that large reverses while the net holds, the ledger's per-section claims need reading differently from its build claims.
FULL_REGISTRY_AUDIT_53_OF_111_AT_RISK_S2.status: CERTIFIED as an audit. It retracts nothing.
FULL_REGISTRY_AUDIT_53_OF_111_AT_RISK_S2.the_lineage_is_validated_even_though_its: S2037 measured S1959's build beating S1789's deployed design by +127.889 milli-nats on fresh rows at t = +47.73, and S2044 confirmed +98.768 at the second coverage. That margin IS the net effect of the entire S1870-S1959 chain. The composition holds even though almost every step inside it is individually in the at-risk regime -- precisely the property the retracted arc lacked. S2013-S2035: fifteen small steps, composition -11.770. S1870-S1959: comparably many small steps, composition +127.889. Small steps are not the problem; small steps whose composition was never checked are.
FULL_REGISTRY_AUDIT_53_OF_111_AT_RISK_S2.what_the_method_cannot_reach: 22 certified entries quote no numeric quantity at all -- S1936's inertness, S1981's non-additivity, S2022's attention result, S2039's untruncation finding among them. Some are structural claims with no margin to quote; others never had their number written into the entry. This method cannot distinguish those cases, so '53 of 111' overstates the precision: the honest figure is 53 at risk, 36 safe by scale, 22 untriageable.

HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_CONTENT_IS_SPECIFIC_AND.claim: Two findings. (1) The high-dimensionality of attention 6's content is NOT generic: a compiled mlp2's content curve is far steeper at every rank -- r1 8.1/8.4/8.1% where attention 6 buys -12.7/-15.4/-21.5%, r16 44.0/45.1/43.7% where attention 6 buys 21.9/20.8/17.0%, differing by 22.1/24.3/26.7 points. Attention 6's content is harder to compress and its low ranks are actively harmful where the MLP's are merely weak. (2) mlp2's content inside the REPAIRED arm is 1.408/1.469/1.436 nats -- 6.6x attention 6's 0.212 and 200x the 0.006 S1983 measured for a lone compiled mlp4.
HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_CONTENT_IS_SPECIFIC_AND.evidence: ops/is_high_dimensional_content_generic.py, 240.5s, nine arms x three roles at 5,419, measured from each site's own mean row. pred_a/b/c all True 3/3, derived controls True, reference deviation 0.000000.
HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_CONTENT_IS_SPECIFIC_AND.open: mlp2's content is 1.4 nats and its rank curve reaches 86% at rank 128 -- the first quantity in this line large enough to be worth BUYING rather than explaining. S1947's price rule is 0.010 nats per 100M parameters and a rank-128 MLP table is a different price from a rank-768 one. Whether the repaired configuration changes the shipped build's allocation is a costing question the ledger has not asked since S1959.
HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_CONTENT_IS_SPECIFIC_AND.scopes: S1983. Its 'content is irrelevant' conclusion holds only at the ceiling.
HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_CONTENT_IS_SPECIFIC_AND.status: CERTIFIED. The S1995 generic control PASSES: the high-dimensionality is specific to attention 6.
HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_CONTENT_IS_SPECIFIC_AND.the_account_restated: A compiled MLP below attention 6 does two separable things. BROKEN (no attention 5 or 6): costs up to the 10.7-nat ceiling, content irrelevant, the interface swamps everything. REPAIRED (attention 5 and 6 compiled): costs 1.5-2.2 nats, of which content is the dominant term at 1.4, with attention 6 contributing 0.2 more.

Top-1 charges at most one position for the same failure and the neighbour still scores 7.7/6.9/5.6% there. That bucket is ~5-7% of scored positions and it reverses the entire pooled CE ranking while leaving the top-1 ranking untouched.

CE: map512 (pooled 5.96702/5.93645/5.96095) > map64 (6.01167/5.98477/6.00165) > nn (6.01897/6.00091/6.00733). Top-1: nn (14.17/14.66/14.24%) > map512 (13.77/14.37/13.72%) > map64 (13.55/14.25/13.64%). The best build under one objective is the worst under the other.

A HALF-CLOSED PATH IS WORSE THAN NONE: mlp2 + attention 2-3 costs 6.893/7.053/6.817, worse than mlp2 alone by 2.08 nats; closing the path through layer 6 drops it to 1.977/2.117/1.906 (step of 4.923 at pooled t = -343.8).

LAYER_6_ATTENTION_IS_THE_WHOLE_PENALTY_S.SCOPE_S1984: S1984 SCOPES THIS CLAIM. Every arm in S1980's sweep had all 18 MLPs and attention 0-5 already substituted; its baseline was 9.266 nats and compiling attention 6 took it to 2.733. That step is real inside that family. Stated generally -- 'live attention at layer 6 reading context-free rows is the whole of the partial-compilation penalty' -- it is FALSE: with only mlp4 compiled, live attention 6 reads context-free rows and compiling it is worth -0.003 nats (10.669 -> 10.666), 0.0% of the penalty against a bar of 80%. LAYER_6_ATTENTION_IS_THE_WHOLE_PENALTY_S.boundary_effect_ruled_out: If the phenomenon were 'whichever live attention layer sits directly above the compiled prefix', compiling layer 6 would move the boundary to layer 7 and buy nothing. Compiling layer 7 next is worth -0.003 to -0.008 nats, slightly NEGATIVE on all three roles. It is layer 6 specifically, not its position relative to the compiled block.

MAP_RANK_TRACKS_TABLE_RANK_S1880.law: map_rank = min(table_rank + 1, 512). §1785 truncates a table as mu + rank-r, so the targets span r+1 dimensions — r directions plus the mean offset — and a rank-r map is one short. A map at or above table_rank+1 is exact within the target subspace and buys nothing more.
MAP_RANK_TRACKS_TABLE_RANK_S1880.practical_rule: Use the matched rank anyway: buying map 512 over map 256 at table rank 256 costs 21.234M for 0.00013 nats = 163,338 M/nat.
MAP_RANK_TRACKS_TABLE_RANK_S1880.scopes: DEPLOYABLE_FALLBACK_SOTA_S1870 — correct for a FULL-RANK-table build (what §1789 deployed), not at table rank <= 64 where the rank-64 map is equal or better and 37.159M cheaper.
MAP_RANK_TRACKS_TABLE_RANK_S1880.status: CERTIFIED — all four predictions TRUE, 18 anchor figures reproduced

MIXING_DAMAGE_IS_LAYERS_6_TO_8_S1979.claim: S1978's 3.6x partial-compilation penalty is local to three layers: with all 18 MLPs substituted, compiling attention at layers 6, 7 and 8 (the k=6->9 step) recovers 6.61-6.77 nats, 88-89% of the entire fall, on 3/3 roles. S1765's consistency requirement is LOCAL -- specifically live attention in the middle third reading context-free rows -- and the other fifteen attention layers reading the same rows cost almost nothing.
MIXING_DAMAGE_IS_LAYERS_6_TO_8_S1979.control_repairs: Two, both my errors and one a real bug. (1) The control asserted 'different spec => must move covered-input top-1', which holds for a table-rank difference but not for a SITE-SUBSET one that shifts CE without flipping any covered argmax. The differing side now requires only that ONE such pair moves and reports the quiet ones; the inert side stays exact. (2) _sites_key hashed an explicit list of all 36 sites differently from None -- two cache entries and two fingerprints for one object, and the reason this plan had no same-spec pair. Normalised, with tests for the full list, ordering and duplicates.
MIXING_DAMAGE_IS_LAYERS_6_TO_8_S1979.evidence: ops/where_the_mixing_hurts.py, 4.6s warm. Eight arms x three roles at 5,419 using bqlib's per-site substitution. pred_a False, pred_b True, pred_c True, derived controls True.
MIXING_DAMAGE_IS_LAYERS_6_TO_8_S1979.open: The best point on this curve is not the one S1765 defines. A program leaving three attention layers live is not a pure function of the current token, so every S1765-derived result -- the exact zero cross-position Jacobians, the covered-input inertness the controls rest on -- would not hold for it. Whether 0.3 nats is worth the analytical frame is the first genuinely architectural question since S1765 itself, and it is a decision rather than an experiment.
MIXING_DAMAGE_IS_LAYERS_6_TO_8_S1979.relation_to_prior_work: S1891/S1908 found the tracking the program destroys is LATE attention; S1978 found EARLY layers cost more to compile. Both are consistent with this and neither predicted it: the damage from MIXING is in the MIDDLE, layers 6-8.
MIXING_DAMAGE_IS_LAYERS_6_TO_8_S1979.the_program_is_not_the_best_point: pred_a FAILED: the fall is not monotone. Compiling attention layers 0-2 is very slightly worse (-0.017 on 3/3) and compiling the LAST THREE (k=15->18) is worse by 0.28-0.32 nats. k=12 and k=15 beat the fully compiled program by ~0.1-0.3 nats on every role. S1765 compiles all 36 sites for DEFINITIONAL reasons -- the program must be a pure function of the current token -- and that definition costs about 0.3 nats against the best partial point, unmeasurable before S1978 because no section could express a partial program.

Rescaling attn5's live output to its table's mean row norm restores 1.07/1.04/1.08x to 7.26/7.37/7.74x against a 7.19/7.29/7.64x baseline.
NORM_RATIO_PREDICTS_COLLAPSE_S1892.control: the all-compiled baseline reproduced §1888 for a fourth consecutive run; unscaled arm reproduced §1891 to two decimals on all four sites
NORM_RATIO_PREDICTS_COLLAPSE_S1892.history: §1892 claimed the live/table norm ratio CAUSES the collapse and orders the sites. §1905 downgraded the ordering to a threshold (Spearman -0.158/-0.212/-0.249 over all 18 sites; attn4 at 35.4x harmless). §1906 removed the causation (amplifying attn3 to an effective 156x gives 9.04x, the best figure measured). §1907 found the separating variable is DIRECTION, at Spearman -0.742. §1908 confirmed the conjunction. Three corrections, all mine, all in place.
NORM_RATIO_PREDICTS_COLLAPSE_S1892.norm_ratio_orders_the_sites: CORRECTED at §1905. Across ALL EIGHTEEN attention sites at 16,110 types the ratio is a THRESHOLD, not an ordering: only attn5 (144.0x) and attn6 (77.1x) exceed 50x and both collapse (1.06/1.32x); all 15 sites at or below 20x stay above 5.0x. But Spearman over the full set is only -0.158/-0.212/-0.249, and attn4 at 35.4x — inside the band §1892's six sites left empty — is completely harmless at 7.16/7.28/7.39. The cliff sits between 35x and 77x; on either side the ratio predicts nothing.
NORM_RATIO_PREDICTS_COLLAPSE_S1892.open: whether the DEPLOYED program's own per-site magnitudes are correct. The tables store length-1 norms; §1804 measured live norms 2.71-152.62x larger. The entire cost arc (§1866-§1883) assumed this away.
NORM_RATIO_PREDICTS_COLLAPSE_S1892.ratios_are_coverage_dependent: attn5 is 156.4x at 5,419 types and 144.0x at 16,110; attn3 14.9x -> 13.0x. Any quantitative use of a ratio must state its coverage.
NORM_RATIO_PREDICTS_COLLAPSE_S1892.status: SUPERSEDED BY ALIGNMENT_TIMES_MAGNITUDE_S1908 — the magnitude account was wrong in three steps
NORM_RATIO_PREDICTS_COLLAPSE_S1892.the_rescale_is_a_mute_not_a_repair: §1892 pred_b FAILED exactly as registered: all six rescaled arms land within 0.11x of the baseline, including attn13 which loses its entire +0.91 gain. At factors of 0.0064-0.094 the restored site contributes at the table's magnitude and the program behaves as if it were still compiled. So at the compiled scale the restored site's DIRECTION barely matters — magnitude alone decides whether restoring a live site helps, does nothing, or destroys the program.

OFF_PATH_COMPILATION_IS_HARMFUL_S1986.claim: The rule is a PATH, and it is optimal, not merely sufficient. mlp4 + attention 4-6 (four sites) costs 1.745/1.853/1.682 nats, BEATING S1985's mlp4 + attention 0-6 by 0.372 at pooled t = -227.1: the three attention layers below the compiled site cost 0.37 and buy nothing. A lone compiled mlp12, above layer 6, costs 0.034/0.036/0.034 -- a factor of 314 cheaper than the identical substitution at mlp4 (10.669), pooled t = -402.1. Compiling attention 6 behind mlp12 makes it 3.8x worse (0.034 -> 0.129, t = +72.4).
OFF_PATH_COMPILATION_IS_HARMFUL_S1986.evidence: ops/how_far_does_the_prefix_reach.py, 53.8s, seven arms x three roles at 5,419. pred_b True; pred_a and pred_c FALSE as registered -- both were two-sided 'within 0.05 nats' bars that a signed improvement or degradation fails. Derived controls True, all three reference deviations 0.000000.
OFF_PATH_COMPILATION_IS_HARMFUL_S1986.open: Layer 6 has been located from below (S1985), from above (S1986) and by content (S1983-S1984), and every result names it without explaining it. The cheapest next probe: compile mlp2 and mlp8 separately and see whether both paths terminate at 6, or whether each site's path ends at its own layer.
OFF_PATH_COMPILATION_IS_HARMFUL_S1986.rule: Compile a site, plus the attention layers between it and attention 6. Compile nothing else. Every off-path site measured so far costs: attention 0-3 under mlp4 (+0.372), attention 6 behind mlp12 (+0.097), the 29 sites between S1985's seven-site arm and the full program (+0.703). S1981 called the cost non-additive; off-path compilation is monotonically harmful, and S1978's 3.6x penalty is the price of compiling everywhere instead of along the path.
OFF_PATH_COMPILATION_IS_HARMFUL_S1986.what_it_does_not_say: These are LOCALISATION PROBES, not candidate programs. Four compiled sites score better than thirty-six partly because thirty-two more of the live model is still present. The CE ordering across different site counts is evidence about where the penalty lives and says nothing about what should ship. The S1979/S1985 architectural fork stands where it did.

ONE_DIRECTION_CARRIES_60_PERCENT_OF_ATTE.claim: A SINGLE DIRECTION recovers 59.2%/61.1%/61.8% of attention 6's entire contribution. Sweeping its table rank inside mlp2 + attention 5,6: rank 1 recovers 59-62%, rank 2 62-65%, rank 4 65-68%, rank 8 67-70%, rank 16 72-74%, rank 384 100%. The curve climbs only 59%->72% from rank 1 to rank 16, so the last 28% needs all 368 remaining dimensions: attention 6's content is one strong direction plus a long flat tail, not 'low-dimensional' in the ordinary sense.
ONE_DIRECTION_CARRIES_60_PERCENT_OF_ATTE.evidence: ops/the_bottom_of_attention_sixs_curve.py, 201.8s, eleven arms x three roles at 5,419, using per-site table ranks. pred_a True 3/3, pred_b True 3/3, pred_c FALSE 3/3. Derived controls True, both reference deviations 0.000000.
ONE_DIRECTION_CARRIES_60_PERCENT_OF_ATTE.open: S2000 measured attention 6's content at 0.212 for a compiled mlp2 and 0.095 for mlp4, a factor of 2.2, and S1999 showed the SIZE is a fact about the pair. Whether the rank-1 FRACTION transfers to mlp4 has not been checked; a fraction that transfers would mean the direction is a property of attention 6 rather than the pair. S2010 runs it.
ONE_DIRECTION_CARRIES_60_PERCENT_OF_ATTE.pred_c_missed_by_0_003: The bar was that attention 5 at RANK 1 sits within 0.02 nats of the full-rank arm; it sits at 0.022/0.023/0.023, short by 0.002/0.003/0.003. The bar came from S2007's +0.001 at rank 16. The substance is unchanged -- rank 1 at attention 5 costs 0.022 where REMOVING attention 5 costs 2.905, so one direction buys 99.2% of the site -- but S2007's 'pure presence' now has a measured floor of about 0.02 nats rather than 0.001.

ONE_MLP_LAYER_4_S1982.claim: Compiling the MLP at layer 4 ALONE -- with all thirty-five other sites live and attention 6 live -- costs 10.58-10.94 nats, the whole of S1981's six-site figure (10.60-10.96) and 3.9x the complete thirty-six-site program (2.70-2.98). One site out of thirty-six, worse than all of them together.
ONE_MLP_LAYER_4_S1982.controls: Derived: coverage exact; same-spec pairs exactly inert at covered inputs; at least one differing-spec pair moves; buckets partition; live per-cell identical; S1975's published converged CE reproduced to 0.000000 via B.ref(). Sixty-first clean reading.
ONE_MLP_LAYER_4_S1982.evidence: ops/which_mlp_below_six.py, 121.9s, declarative. Nine arms x three roles at 5,419. pred_a True, pred_b False, pred_c False, derived controls True.
ONE_MLP_LAYER_4_S1982.not_propagation: pred_b FAILED. I predicted mlp0 would be costliest, its compiled row passing through the most live machinery. The gradient runs the other way up to layer 4 -- 1.35, 2.16, 4.81, 6.57, 10.67 -- then COLLAPSES at layer 5 to 2.02, one layer closer to the interface. Not distance, not depth, not adjacency: layer 4.
ONE_MLP_LAYER_4_S1982.open: The pair is named and nothing says what passes between them. The halves are one layer apart, so whatever mlp4 writes reaches attn6 through layer 5 -- and layer 5's own MLP, compiled alone, costs 2.0 nats. S1908's alignment x magnitude instrument decomposes a site's contribution into direction and size and would say which the compiled mlp4 row gets wrong; it has never been pointed at an MLP.
ONE_MLP_LAYER_4_S1982.strongly_subadditive: pred_c FAILED in the completing direction: the singles sum to 27.4-28.9 nats while the six together cost 10.6-11.0. They overlap almost entirely because mlp4 already does all of it. S1981 found the cost non-additive; this says which way it fails, having asked the opposite.
ONE_MLP_LAYER_4_S1982.the_pair: The 2.7-nat premise (S1977), the 3.6x partial penalty (S1978), the three-layer step (S1979), the one attention layer (S1980) and the six MLPs (S1981) all reduce to ONE PAIR OF SITES: a compiled MLP at layer 4 feeding a live attention at layer 6. Break either half -- compile layer 6's attention (S1980) or leave layer 4's MLP live -- and the penalty is gone. Thirty-four of thirty-six sites are indifferent to what their inputs are made of.

PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.attention_carries_it: attn_only costs 96% of the full price on 3/3 roles -- substituting attention alone buys essentially the entire penalty, which is S1977's 'attention is worth ~2.7 nats' measured directly. pred_a failed only because it compared attn_only against the INCONSISTENT mlp_only arm, two things differing in two ways.
PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.claim: Substituting only the 18 MLP sites costs 10.2-10.6 nats against the live model -- 3.6x the price of substituting all 36 (2.70-2.98) -- on 3/3 roles at 355-378%. A partially compiled program is far worse than a fully compiled one: context-free MLP rows feed into LIVE attention which mixes them across positions, and the result is worse than either the live model or the program. S1765's object is internally consistent, and the consistency is load-bearing.
PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.controls: Derived: coverage exact; same-spec pairs inert at covered inputs and differing-spec pairs not, with the SITE SUBSET now part of 'same spec'; buckets partition; live per-cell identical; S1975's published converged CE reproduced to 0.000000 via B.ref(). Fifty-seventh clean reading.
PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.early_beats_late: pred_c FAILED and reverses the expectation: the EARLY half costs more (80-81%) than the late half (66-67%). S1891/S1908 asked which site's ablation destroys the PROGRAM's behaviour; this asks which substitution costs most CE against the LIVE model. Compiling early layers starves everything downstream of context; late layers still receive contextualised input. Two different questions about the same sites.
PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.evidence: ops/what_the_program_gives_up.py, 125.3s, declarative, using bqlib's new per-site substitution subsets. Six arms x three roles at 5,419. All three predicates FALSE, derived controls TRUE.
PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.open: The 3.6x penalty says compiled and live components interact badly but not where. attn_only at 96% and mlp_only at 368% are the two halves of one partition and differ by a factor of four, so the damage is not symmetric 'mixing' -- it is specifically LIVE ATTENTION READING CONTEXT-FREE ROWS. Which layer's live attention does the damage is one sweep away and would say whether the consistency requirement is global or local.
PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.status: CERTIFIED. S1884 asked whether the program is 'a degraded copy' and answered no on other evidence; this is that claim with a number, and the number is 3.6x.
PARTIAL_COMPILATION_IS_WORSE_THAN_FULL_S.sublinearity: pred_b FAILED in the opposite direction to the one tested: every consistent partial costs two-thirds to four-fifths of the full price, not under half. The substitution is strongly sublinear -- the first sites compiled cost most of the price -- which is why S1946-S1976's parameter tuning, all downstream of a fully compiled program, was working in the flat tail.

PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.claim: Varying the blend weight PER TOKEN by unc_mass quantile does raise the unseen (0-0) bucket -- +0.40/+0.32/+0.09pp at 5,419 for the widest tilt, 3/3 roles there and 2/3 at 16,110 -- and it acts through the intended mechanism (the WIDEST tilt is best on 3/3 roles at 5,419). But it costs +1.50 to +3.04 milli-nats of pooled CE at 5,419, above the 0.002-nat bar on 2 of 3 roles. It buys the bucket by paying CE: the same trade S1955/S1956 rejected as routing, in a new form.
PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.closes_the_residual: Four attempts have now been made on the unseen-target deficit -- a cosine router (S1939), a mass router (S1955), the same at the other coverage (S1956), and a per-token weight (S1963). Every one either fails to move it or moves it by paying more CE than it is worth. The blend's inability to reach a target no fit row contains is STRUCTURAL (S1937/S1938); the deficit should be reported as the cost of the blend rather than engineered around. At 16,110 the price is milder (pred_b passes 3/3, and skip1200 is free) so it is coverage-dependent, but the sign never reverses.
PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.controls: coverages exact; plan-derived control non-vacuous both ways (10 same-spec pairs inert, 5 differing-spec not); buckets partition; live per-cell identical at 0.00e+00; S1961's pooled CE reproduced to 0.000000 via B.ref() with an explicit coverage. Forty-seventh clean reading.
PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.corrects: S1962's control paragraph (the registered clause was overwritten; re-run with it, pred_d still passes and pred_a/b/c are unchanged)
PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.evidence: ops/per_token_alpha.py, 9.5s warm. Six builds x three roles x two coverages. pred_a True, pred_b False, pred_c True 3/3, pred_d True.
PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.infrastructure_found: Two defects surfaced by this section's own controls. (1) B.ref() silently returned the FIRST coverage of a two-coverage artifact -- a helper written to stop a reference being wrong, picking one arbitrarily. It now raises unless told which, and ops/test_fast.py checks both the raise and the explicit path. (2) The gate learned that a module-level LOWERCASE name assigned twice is a fork leftover: 7 of 245 scripts flagged, all genuine, 0 false positives -- which exposed that S1962's registered pred_d clause never ran, an inherited assignment having overwritten it.
PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.scoped_by: S1965: the "structural price at every operating point" framing holds at 5,419 and FAILS at 16,110 on the shipped build, where the narrow tilt clears the 0.002-nat bar on 3/3 (+0.47/+0.39/-0.49 milli-nats). The inability to reach an unseen target is structural; the price of tilting against it scales with the fallback share of scored positions.
PER_TOKEN_ALPHA_WORKS_AND_STILL_PAYS_S19.status: CERTIFIED. The deployable conclusion is a NEGATIVE and it closes the line.

POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.claim: Auditing every result artifact in the tree under pooled paired statistics (190 comparisons carrying three roles): only 6 show the 2-of-3 sign vote disagreeing with the pooled sign, all at |t| <= 0.51 on differences of 0.016-0.116 milli-nats; 41 are 'at risk' (skip1200 supported the majority and pooled |t| < 2); and 40 are unambiguous at pooled |t| >= 10. Six of the 47 involve a build-level arm, all from S1966 and all sign-consistent sub-2-sigma (see correction).
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.contrast_with_S1965: The six genuine vote-vs-pooling disagreements are all inside the noise -- a vote over unequal roles disagrees with the evidence exactly where there is no evidence. S1965 was a different failure: its vote passed a CHEAPNESS bar while the pooled evidence said 'worse', and that is the one that cost a published claim.
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.correction: The published line 'NOT ONE of the 47 problematic comparisons involves a build-level arm' was WRONG: six do, all from S1966's one_build_with_tilt -- spec_5419 vs spec_16110 at 5,419 (pooled -0.522m, t=-1.77) and the mid_* arms vs spec_5419 at 16,110 (-0.021 to -0.031m, |t|<=0.97). None is a sign disagreement; all are sign-consistent and sub-2-sigma, which is exactly what S1966's own pred_b concluded, so no result moves. Cause: I grepped the audit's printed at-risk list, truncated to risk[:12], instead of the data. LESSON 92, third instance of that shape.
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.evidence: ops/pooling_audit.py, no GPU. A paired difference pools exactly from per-role mean/se/n, so the arc is re-readable from disk.
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.mechanism: ops/pooling_audit.py now exits non-zero on the S1965 SHAPE -- a build-level comparison where the vote and the pooled sign disagree -- and is wired into ops/test_fast.py, so it gates enqueue. It caught this very overclaim four minutes after it was written. It no longer truncates its own output.
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.method_note: The audit reads 190 comparisons out of artifacts written across S1935-S1973 by both the hand-forked and declarative forms, only possible because every one recorded per-role mean, se and n rather than a bare verdict. Recording the MARGIN rather than the boolean made a retrospective re-analysis possible at zero cost.
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.open: ops/pooling_audit.py runs over the whole tree in seconds and is wired to nothing. The same arithmetic could gate a section at write-up time -- refusing a 2-of-3 without its pooled t alongside -- turning S1972's lesson (significance to believe, magnitude to buy) into a mechanism rather than a resolution.
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.status: CERTIFIED. The arc's structural conclusions stand as published.
POOLING_AUDIT_CLEARS_THE_ARC_S1974.where_the_risk_lives: All 47 live inside the alpha sweep (14), the tilt sweep (3+3) or the tilt-compromise run (1) -- the axes S1972 and S1973 already priced at 0.4% of the build's margin and nothing respectively. The comparisons that decide the build (deployed vs converged, map ranks, allocations) are among the 40 at pooled |t| >= 10, where a half-sized role cannot change the answer.

PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.S1884_inversion_resolved: §1884's struck pred_c was directionally right (rare imitates slightly more) but 40x overstated: 1.17x, not 45x. The strike remains correct — its null was 5-16x too low and its 97x enrichment is 15x the true 6.3x. §1885 pred_c FAILED its own 10x bar on skip11000 (5x), so the claim "the old baseline was badly wrong on every role" does not hold; "badly wrong" does.
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.claim: On its strongest bucket (targets seen 125+ times) §1882's half-cost build gets 81.4/82.5/80.7% of its correct top-1 predictions on positions the LIVE MODEL also gets right. About one in five of its correct answers are positions where the model itself is wrong, so the program is not simply a degraded copy of the model — it is a different predictor overlapping it.
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.open: whether the agreement is carried by a few of the 36 sites or spread across all of them — the first question in this arc about mechanism rather than price
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.permutation_null_S1885: Enrichment of top-1 agreement over a permutation null (shuffled within bucket, marginals preserved): 125+ bucket 5.36/5.57/5.42x; fit-count-0 bucket 6.41/6.34/6.31x; middle buckets 7.5-8.2x. A permutation-matched independent pair sits at 1.0x (calibrated: 0.977x on known-independent synthetic draws, 15.6x on a known 40%-copier). The DEFLATIONARY reading — that the agreement is explained by shared token marginals — is EXCLUDED.
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.raw_agreement: top-1 agreement with the live model on the 125+ bucket: 34.6/35.1/34.7%, against the program's own accuracy of 29.0-30.9% and the model's 54.6-57.6%.
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.reading: The program copies the model's ERRORS most faithfully where the model errs most: on rare targets it is right 0.6-1.3% of the time while tracking the model 6.3x above chance. On frequent targets enrichment is LOWER (5.4x) because both are more often independently correct. Combined with the 81.4/82.5/80.7% overlap, it is a degraded copy that is nonetheless right on a partly different set.
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.replication_S1886: The DEPLOYED build (full-rank tables, rank-64 map) tracks the live model at 5.84/5.78/5.77x the permutation null on the 125+ bucket and 6.96/6.86/6.78x on fit-count-0 — within 0.48/0.21/0.35x of the half-cost build. The tracking is a property of the compiled program, not of the rank-512 SVD truncation, which §1883 had just shown is not neutral. The rare>common ordering holds on both builds at the same ~1.18x margin.
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.settled_statement: The compiled 36-site program tracks the live model's top-1 at ~5.8x chance on frequent targets and ~6.9x on targets it has never seen, while being correct on the latter only 2.6-4.9% as often as the model. It reproduces the model's predictions — errors included — most faithfully where those predictions are worst. The deployed and 46%-cheaper builds do this to the same degree.
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.status: CERTIFIED — confirmed second-class on a second build (§1886), all four predictions TRUE
PROGRAM_IS_NOT_A_DEGRADED_COPY_S1884.struck: §1884 pred_a and pred_c used acc_live*acc_prog as the chance baseline for AGREEMENT. That is the both-right probability, not chance agreement; it assumes wrong answers scatter uniformly over 50,257 tokens when both predictors concentrate on frequent ones. The resulting "97x enrichment" on the rare bucket is an artifact of the denominator collapsing where accuracy is low. Neither ratio should be cited. Correct null = permutation control (§1885).

PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.claim: Restricted to the ~60% of covered scored positions where BOTH the program and the live model are WRONG, the program's top-1 matches the model's at 22.76/20.75/24.06% against a permutation null of 3.73/3.33/3.70% — 6.10/6.24/6.50x, on 16856/15857/8487 positions. The program makes the model's specific mistakes, not merely mistakes in the same places.
PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.control: cells partition exactly; §1888 enrichment AND §1858 CE both reproduced in the same run
PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.excludes: the alternative §1885 could not rule out and §1893/§1894 revived — that the 5-8x aggregate tracking is carried by easy positions any two competent predictors share. The both-wrong cell contains no easy positions by construction and reproduces the aggregate (6.1-6.5x vs 7.19/7.29/7.64x).
PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.line_summary: The compiled 36-site program is neither a subset of the live model nor an independent predictor. It reproduces the model's specific outputs — correct and incorrect alike — at 6-8x a marginal-matched null, on two builds, two coverages, and restricted to both-wrong positions. Carried by the table lookups at 2.3x the fallback's rate and by late attention (all 18 MLP restorations are provable no-ops). Simultaneously right on a set the model misses one time in six.
PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.program_only_right: 16.9/15.8/18.7% at 5,419 (§1895), 17.3/16.5/19.3% at 16,110 (§1896), 19% on the 125+ bucket (§1884) — three populations, one claim: about one in six of the program's correct answers are positions the live model gets wrong.
PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.reconciles_S1893_S1894: scaling tables to x0.50 buys agreement (8.27x) while costing accuracy (CE 6.18 vs 6.01) because more agreement means more faithfully reproduced MISTAKES. The instruments were never in conflict: agreement measures fidelity to a model that is wrong 62-75% of the time here.
PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.replication_S1896: At 16,110 types the both-wrong enrichment is 6.23/6.18/6.49x against §1895's 6.10/6.24/6.50x — a difference of 0.13/0.06/0.01x, two roles agreeing to within a hundredth, on 19618/18650/9847 positions. Tripling coverage changes the covered population (model-only grows from 25.7/27.5/24.9% to 26.9/29.1/26.4%) and the effect does not move.
PROGRAM_REPRODUCES_THE_MODELS_MISTAKES_S.status: CERTIFIED — confirmed second-class at a second coverage (§1896), all four predictions TRUE

RANK_768_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_AT_MLP16_AN.S2013_does_not_generalise: At mlp2, whose entire table content is 0.0001 nats, rank 128 is marginally justified (costs 0.00025 against 0.00042 of parameters). At mlp17 the same truncation costs 0.0084-0.0101. A uniform rank read off mlp2 would be a 20-fold error at mlp17.
RANK_768_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_AT_MLP16_AN.claim: Every truncation below rank 768 loses money at the two sites that carry the shipped program. Rank 128 costs +0.00565/+0.00608/+0.00503 at mlp16 and +0.01006/+0.00857/+0.00844 at mlp17 -- 12x to 24x the 0.00042 nats its 4.205M saved values are worth. Rank 384 costs +0.00259/+0.00199/+0.00125 and +0.00285/+0.00288/+0.00193, 5x to 12x its own 0.00025 price. S1959's uniform rank 768 is correctly bought where the program actually lives.
RANK_768_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_AT_MLP16_AN.evidence: ops/rank_at_the_two_sites_that_matter.py, 445.4s, eight arms x three roles at 5,419. pred_a/b/c/d all True 3/3, derived controls True, reference deviation 0.000000.
RANK_768_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_AT_MLP16_AN.independent_replication_of_S2014: Truncating both sites costs +0.01941/+0.01851/+0.01727 against a sum of +0.01571/+0.01465/+0.01347 -- super-additive by 24%, where S2014 measured 22% on entirely different arms (mean rows at mlp2, mlp3 and mlp12). Two measurements of the same nonlinearity from different interventions, agreeing to two points.
RANK_768_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_AT_MLP16_AN.open: Every rank tested is BELOW 768, and 768 is itself a truncation -- the untruncated table at 5,419 coverage has rank 1152. Whether mlp16 and mlp17 are leaving content on the table above 768 has never been asked, and it is the one direction in which the allocation could still be wrong. S2017 runs it.
RANK_768_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_AT_MLP16_AN.the_curve_is_convex: Rank 384 costs 0.23 to 0.46 of what rank 128 costs, for 60% of the saving -- a middle rank is the better buy IF one were buying, but at 5-12x the price none of them is.
RANK_768_IS_CORRECTLY_BOUGHT_AT_MLP16_AN.where_the_build_stands: Table content concentrated in mlp16 and mlp17 (S2015); rank correctly bought there by 5-24x (S2016); shallow tables nearly free to degrade but their parameters worth ten times less than degrading them costs (S2015); the whole program super-additive in loss by 22-24% so per-site decisions do not add (S2014, S2016). NO ALLOCATION CHANGE IS INDICATED, and that is a result rather than an absence of one.

RANK_768_IS_SLIGHTLY_UNDER_BOUGHT_AT_MLP.claim: Untruncating mlp17 from the shipped rank 768 to its own rank 1152 buys 0.00063/0.00030/0.00051 nats against S1947's 0.00025 price -- 1.2x to 2.5x, on 3/3 roles, at pooled t = -3.58. mlp16 does NOT qualify: it buys +0.00102 and +0.00053 on two roles and -0.00008 on skip1200. And raising BOTH buys LESS than the sum of raising each (0.00105 vs 0.00116, 0.00120 vs 0.00131, 0.00031 vs 0.00043) -- improvements are SUB-additive by 10-28%, where S2014 and S2016 both measured degradations as SUPER-additive by 22-24%.
RANK_768_IS_SLIGHTLY_UNDER_BOUGHT_AT_MLP.evidence: ops/is_768_leaving_content_on_the_table.py, 267.4s, six arms x three roles at 5,419. pred_a True 3/3, pred_c True; pred_b FALSE (mlp16 negative on one role), pred_d FALSE 3/3. Derived controls True, reference deviation 0.000000.
RANK_768_IS_SLIGHTLY_UNDER_BOUGHT_AT_MLP.open: Every number is at 5,419. S1993 and S2008 found this family stable at 16,110, but S1963 and S1965 reversed 5,419 claims twice, and a 0.0005-nat margin is exactly the size a coverage change could erase.
RANK_768_IS_SLIGHTLY_UNDER_BOUGHT_AT_MLP.status: CERTIFIED as a discovery-run margin. NOT a build change: the house pattern is to score a candidate build end-to-end at both coverages, which S2018 does.
RANK_768_IS_SLIGHTLY_UNDER_BOUGHT_AT_MLP.the_nonlinearity_has_a_sign: Same loss curvature, opposite sign of perturbation: moving away from the program's optimum compounds, moving toward it saturates. I registered that the nonlinearity should make improvements compound too; it does the opposite, which is a cleaner statement about the loss than the one I expected.
RANK_768_IS_SLIGHTLY_UNDER_BOUGHT_AT_MLP.what_it_recommends: mlp17 at rank 1152 is justified under S1947's price rule on 3/3 roles, by 1.2-2.5x, for +2.52M values on a 189.5M build -- a 1.3% price rise for 0.0005 nats. That is a real but small margin on a rule whose bar is itself 0.010 per 100M. mlp16 is not justified.

RANK_ONE_IS_PRESENCE_NOT_CONTENT_S2010.claim: Attention 6's rank-1 share of its whole contribution is 59-62% at a compiled mlp2 and 98.1-98.3% at a compiled mlp4 -- it does not transfer, failing a 10-point bar by 36.5 to 39.0 points. The reason is that the rank-1 fraction tracks the PRESENCE share (63.8/66.3/68.6% at mlp2, 98.5/98.5/98.8% at mlp4) and sits slightly BELOW it on all six cells. Rank 1 at attention 6 is very slightly worse than a constant row: it delivers presence and none of the content.
RANK_ONE_IS_PRESENCE_NOT_CONTENT_S2010.evidence: ops/is_the_rank_one_direction_the_same.py, 162.8s, twelve arms x three roles at 5,419, with both sites' fractions computed in-run. pred_a True 3/3, pred_c True 3/3, pred_b FALSE 3/3. Derived controls True, all three reference deviations 0.000000.
RANK_ONE_IS_PRESENCE_NOT_CONTENT_S2010.open: Three sections have tried to characterise attention 6's content by rank and each measured the presence floor instead. The instrument that separates them is the MEAN ROW, not the rank sweep: the content is exactly (meanrow - table), and its rank structure needs a sweep run relative to the mean row rather than to the no-attention-6 arm.
RANK_ONE_IS_PRESENCE_NOT_CONTENT_S2010.status: CERTIFIED, and it RETRACTS the headline of S2009.
RANK_ONE_IS_PRESENCE_NOT_CONTENT_S2010.the_correct_statement: Attention 6's contribution to a compiled MLP is mostly PRESENCE -- 98.5% at mlp4, 64-69% at mlp2 -- and the presence part is delivered by any context-free row, a constant one or a rank-1 table alike. The CONTENT part is small (0.095 at mlp4, 0.212 at mlp2) and needs real rank: rank 16 recovers only 12 points more than rank 1 at mlp2, and the last 28 points need all 368 remaining dimensions.

REDISTRIBUTION_IS_TWO_LEVERS_S1933.claim: §1932's apparent frequent-to-rare "redistribution" at the deployed coverage is a superposition of two independent levers, not a trade. With the map fixed at rank 512, cutting table rank full->256 lowers BOTH buckets (125+ 63.1->62.0, 62.1->61.3, 62.8->61.9; unseen 4.0->3.5, 6.7->5.2, 4.0->3.5). Raising the MAP from rank 64 to 512 at fixed full table rank raises the unseen bucket 2.7->4.0, 6.2->6.7, 3.6->4.0 (+1.3/+0.5/+0.4pp). Nothing is moved.

A weighted or POOLED-ACROSS-ROLES paired test would settle a 2-of-3 without a vote at all, and the per-position data for every arm is already cached -- arithmetic on disk rather than a run. That is the instrument this arc should have had.
ROLES_ARE_NOT_INTERCHANGEABLE_S1971.status: CERTIFIED as a methodological finding about the whole arc.
ROLES_ARE_NOT_INTERCHANGEABLE_S1971.what_it_does_not_change: No result is overturned: the 3-of-3 findings are untouched and per-role margins have been quoted throughout, so the numbers needed to re-weight are already in the ledger and artifacts. THE_CEILING_IS_COVERAGE_INVARIANT_S2008.claim: The S2004 ceiling and the S2006 lever replicate at 16,110 types, and the ceiling is coverage-INVARIANT to 0.001 nats. The three ceiling arms move 10.669->10.670, 10.701->10.700 and 10.669->10.670 when the table's coverage triples, while the full 36-site program moves 0.064 (2.808->2.744), the repaired arm 0.008 and the lever arm 0.038. THE_CEILING_IS_COVERAGE_INVARIANT_S2008.open: Attention 6's content is the one thing still unexplained: worth 0.08-0.22 nats, with rank 16 recovering 72% (S1996). If rank 4 or rank 2 recovers most of it, the signal is small enough that a head-level account becomes the obvious next instrument rather than a speculation. S2009 runs it.
THE_CEILING_IS_COVERAGE_INVARIANT_S2008.why_it_matters: Coverage acts only on the UNCOVERED arm -- S1870's map, the guessing part. A quantity that does not move when coverage triples is not about the fallback. S1994 showed 90-95% of the threshold's gap sits at covered inputs; S2008 shows the ceiling is coverage-invariant to the third decimal. The 10.7 nats are a fact about what a live attention 6 does with context-free input, and nothing about how the program fills in tokens it has not seen.
